name: The Academy
description:
The Academy is a TVB modern drama series broadcast in June 2005.

The series follows the lives of a group of new Hong Kong Police recruits as they proceed through training at the Hong Kong Police training school. Within these 27 weeks, each of them learned their lessons, each of them become more mature, each of them become a better person as the relationship between the trainees and the trainers grows stronger and stronger.

A direct sequel, "On the First Beat" was produced and broadcast in 2007 continued with Ron Ng and Sammul Chan, alongside Joey Yung, Sonija Kwok and Michael Tao. Another sequel, "E.U." was produced and released in 2009 continued with Ron Ng and Sammul Chan, alongside Michael Miu, Kathy Chow, Elanne Kong, and Michael Tse. Michael Miu reprises a new role as a triad boss in E.U., which is unrelated to his role in The Academy.

credits_cast.character: 李柏翘/韦柏翘 Lee Pak-Kiu / Wai Pak Kiu
credits_cast.name: Sammul Chan

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: CHUNG LAP MAN has always thought that LEE MAN SING, an instructor of the Police Training School, is the one who destroyed his family. To revenge him, MAN forces a friend of his, CHAN KWOK KEUNG, to take part in the police recruitment exam with him. On the selection day, MAN has a disagreement with another candidate, KEN WAI. It is MAN’s wish that his mother, CHAN YIN TING, could one day be reunited with his father, CHUNG CHI WAH. And so he keeps creating chances for his parents. TING feels that there is nothing she can do about MAN’s effort. TING is upset because her interior design company, Lok On Kui, has been doing very badly. She has withdrawn 50,000 dollars, which is meant to pay a decoration contractor, from the bank. Unfortunately, she has been robbed and the money has all gone. She feels helpless. A young woman named HO FA has witnessed the whole incident and is very uneasy about this……

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: KEN is worrying about his rental when his grandpa, CHIU TIM FOOK, comes. Knowing KEN’s problem, FOOK tells him that his mother, LEUNG SAU CHUN, had bought a house with SING twenty years ago. FOOK also tells him to get back what he deserves. So KEN goes to SING’s place. There, he is mistaken as a thief by SING’s co-habitant-cum-colleague, KUK MING CHEONG. When SING learns that KEN is the son of CHUN, he lets KEN move in. A woman wrongly accuses FA of stealing in a record shop. MAN sees this and comes to her rescue. However, FA still has not recovered from the fright. MAN and his sister, KA LAI, are on the way to buy a cell phone when they see a man stealing a pedestrian’s mobile. MAN gives a chase without delay. FA is all too worried as her twin brother, MING, is the pickpocket. MING is caught. MAN appears in court to testify against MING. MING is convicted and sentenced to prison for three months. The HO family hates MAN……

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: FIONA MA, who is also a cadet, suspects that SING was the traffic policeman who had once saved her life, but he makes no response to her queries. KEN reports MAN and KEUNG’s rearrangement to SING. Both MAN and KEUNG are angry. The cadets are given their uniforms and arranged to have their hair cut. The female cadets weep over their short hairdos. ANN talks to every cadet in her team individually. After talking to them all, she has got the impression that KEN is very self-protective; that FIONA, who is delicate, may not be able to go through the training. As for MAN, he complained that SING always picks on him. FIONA has damaged the iron, so she has to borrow one from the male cadets. Meanwhile, SING comes for an inspection blitz and orders the cadets to clean the toilets once again. SING sees FIONA there. As a result, all the female cadets are asked to copy the school regulations out as a punishment……

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: ANN is very friendly; all the cadets have a favorable impression on her. MAN is delighted to know FA is the temporary staff at the school canteen. CHEONG teaches the cadets shooting. MAN is skeptical about him, whose nickname is Marksman. MAN has dropped SING’s notepad onto the street, making all to be punished. SING scolds the cadets for lacking team spirit and reproaches MAN, who is a class captain, for being irresponsible. The boys are dissatisfied that SING punishes them again. FIONA reports to SING her roommates’ eating snacks in the barrack, which is against the rules. Nevertheless, she is told off by SING instead. FA takes away MAN’s uniform, hoping that he would be punished for losing his uniform. MAN is upset that he cannot have a weekend off because he has filled in the wrong date on the leave application form. FIONA and KEN go shopping for swimming suits for their whole classes……

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: MAN hurries to hospital. To his huge relieve, TING is in good shape. CHEONG confesses to SING he has broken the music box. SING tells him to forget about it and let KEN misunderstand him. KEN looks everywhere but fails to find somebody who can fix his music box. FIONA, who is wearing a wig, attends a luncheon. There she bumps into her childhood playmate, CHOW WAI YUEN, but she cannot recognize him. A waiter takes off her wig by accident. Her mother, CHEUNG WAI SUM, is shocked to see her short hair and orders her to quit the school. Her father, FUNG TAI, comes to her rescue. TING has been discharged from hospital. Her elder sister, YIN LAN, moves in under the pretext of looking after her, to which MAN and LAI are unhappy. SING goes to his superior, PANG HO LEUNG, and speaks for MAN regarding his leaving the school without permission. MAN is only given a warning letter but no other punishment in the end……

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: MAN and KEN are scolded by SING during training. The two switch off the tap to revenge SING when he is taking a shower. KEN later turns himself in. MAN appreciates KEN’s help and they become good friends. FIONA has accidentally cut off the power of the female barrack. Her fellow cadets refuse to give her a help later when she twists her ankle. FIONA takes part in the foot-drill despite her pain. She ends up bringing a punishment to LING. FA gives FIONA a hand in taking the meal. The two girls find themselves get along very well. SUM has borrowed tens of thousand of dollars from the loan shark. FA does not want to steal again and help her father pay his debt. The girls take a peep at FIONA’s diary and laugh at her for admiring SING. There is an angioma in TING’s brain; she asks SING to keep it a secret. The fortnightly test is round the corner. MAN is so nervous that he has got stomach ache……

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: SING points out that what the guys have done is against the police’s code of practice. When home, KEN has a quarrel with SING. KEN leaves the house in anger. CHEONG advises SING not to be too harsh to the cadets but to give them more room. MAN is studying at home when he gets stomach ache again. TING suggests the whole family to go to the countryside on Sunday to reduce MAN’s pressure. Coveting the 10,000 dollars prize money, FA takes part in the Miss Sunny Pageant. Her plan is disrupted unintentionally by MAN. Their relationship has become even worse. Some loan sharks have come and ask FA pay off her father’s debt. FA, who is scared, does not know what to do. Luckily, FIONA is there to help her out of the predicament. FIONA is depressed that her classmates do not like her, and she is thinking about quitting. Her parents are excited to hear this. FA encourages her to hang on in there and fight for her dream……

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The day before the fortnightly test, the class is very dissatisfied that SING has extended the foot-drill training. That night, KEN takes everybody out for a chill-out. On the day of the test, everybody is very nervous. SING accompanies TING to the herbal doctor’s and takes her home. LAN asks her if she is going out with SING and she is pleased to hear that SING is only a friend of hers. All have passed the test. To their disappointment, MAN does not appreciate their result at all. Rather, he orders them to practice more. The youngsters can do nothing but suppress their rage. CHEONG is upset that ANN makes him lose face front of other officers. He reveals to SING that he and ANN were lovers ten years ago. PONG appears to be very nervous during the riflery and fighting courses. He is also found to be absent-minded the whole day. Some of his fellows think that he is possessed, but MAN does not believe so……

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The cadets have learnt that PONG’s father, KWOK PUI, was SING’s superior. They tease that he has someone there to support him in the back. PONG is unhappy. Both SING and KEN have noticed that PONG has been behaving oddly, yet he denies. MAN has lost his cell phone and suspects that FA has stolen it. MAN follows FA, and sees her, together with FIONA, taking an old lady, who is lost, home. FA has helped the old lady found her grandson, SHEK CHAI. FIONA has left her cell phone there, nevertheless. PONG is performing very badly again at the firing range. SING suggests him taking a rest at home but he insists that he is fine. MAN suggests firing a complaint against SING for putting too much pressure on PONG and asking for a transfer of SING. KEN does not agree with his ideas, ending up being boycotted. SING and ANN give the cadets a pop physical test. PONG collapses during the test and is taken to hospital……

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: ANN apologizes to SING for mistaking his handling of PONG’s leaving the school. She further asks him how he is going to handle the discontent among his class. SING replies that he is not going to change her teaching method. MAN has found his cell phone at last. He apologizes to FA for blaming her, but she refuses to accept his apology. FIONA worries that she would one day be kicked out like PONG. KEN goes and comforts her. MAN learns that TING is jogging with SING the next morning, so he eggs her on going with TING to get close to SING. Things turn out the opposite, however. ANN bumps into CHEONG while she walking the dog. The two have a war of words. The male cadets are watching a VCD in the barrack when KEN sees SING on his way to come for an inspection. He draws him away with an excuse but his plot fails. The other cadets mistakes that KEN is the informer and give him the cold shoulder……

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: It’s payday. KEN treats FOOK to a meal while FIONA and FA go on a shopping spree. YUEN nearly runs into FA as he is driving. He buys her a lot of clothing as compensation, leaving a good impression on her. SUM’s second-hand commodity has been made a mess of by some guys. MAN and KEUNG help him scare away the guys. SUM recognizes that MAN was the one who led to MING’s imprisonment and so gives chase to him. After knowing that the poor life her classmate TAO SHUK CHING leads, and that she cannot even afford to buy her younger brother and sister chips, FIONA reflects on her luxurious way of living. What’s more, she decides not to use the supplementary credit card that her parents gave her any more. KEUNG has picked KEN’s wallet, which he has lost earlier. He goes with MAN to KEN’s home, where they discover that KEN lives with SING. They therefore are more convinced that SING is taking special care of KEN and they despise KEN even more……

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: MAN has found KEN at last. He accuses him of causing them trouble on purpose. MAN does not know until later that it is in fact the idea of their instructors to test the class’ team spirit. The training continues. MAN has led the team into the wrong route and they get lost. KEN is doubtful about MAN’s ability. The two have a dispute again. Seeing this, SING appoints CHUEN to be the leader of Team A instead. MAN is unhappy. ANN has the flu. She collapses later because of sunstroke. CHEONG holds her in the arms and takes her to the medical room. He also takes her home and cooks her some porridge. ANN finds him very sweet. Team B gets to the campsite first. As FIONA did not bring along the gas, the team cannot light a fire. Team C offers to lend them some. The next morning, FIONA is appointed to be the leader, to which KEI is unhappy. KEI is scared to death when she sees a poisonous snake……

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: FIONA cannot swim. She feels helpless in the swimming and life-saving trainings. She turns to KEN for assistance after class. LAN realizes that she has left her wallet at home when she is in the supermarket. Luckily, SING is there and he pays for her. LAN believes that it is fate that she and SING should have met. SING has come for dinner. LAI is displeased and goes out. TING plans to pair up LAN and SING as she knows LAN is very fond of him. SING praises KEN in front of everybody for his foot-drill. While MAN is not happy, FIONA is glad. FA and FIONA ask KEUNG why MAN and KEN have fallen out. He tells them that it is because SING shows partiality to KEN. KEUNG also reveals that SING and KEN live together. KEN’s secret has been spread to the whole school. He believes that this is the work of MAN. The misunderstanding between them deepens. FIONA cancels the appointment with YUEN and asks KEN to teach her swim……

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Classes A and Class B are punished to extend their foot-drill because of MAN. ON CHI HO, captain of Class B, blames MAN. KEN stands out to defend MAN, who, however, is not grateful to him at all. FA is pleased to receive an SMS from YUEN. While FIONA teases her for this, she also tells FA that she likes KEN. LAI has got high marks in the English test. She plans to ask for rewards from TING. Nevertheless, TING is nowhere to be seen when she gets home. So she goes out again with friends. When she learns that LAI is upset, TING buys her a new MP3 cell phone. To her surprise, LAI does not seem to be happy at all. It is KEN’s late mother’s birthday. KEN goes and visits her grave. He is astounded to bump into SING there. FA tells MAN that LAI has sold her cell phone again. MAN finds LAI in a karaoke bar. He gives her a telling-off for going out with bad guys. She, who is furious, leaves without saying a word……

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: SING gives MAN two heavy punches and tells him that the harm he has done to his mother is even more harmful than the punches. This is as if a blot to MAN and he realizes his wrong at last. After the foot-drill training, the cadets take out their childhood photo and have a good chat. Everybody enjoys the chat very much except KEN, who feels bitter instead. SING deliberately put KEN and MAN in the same team in the training, hoping that they can work together as a team in climbing the high stage. However, he is disappointed that the two guys still refuse to put down their egoism but always try to outdo the other. They lose as a result. ANN’s boyfriend has come to the training school to give out wedding invitations. CHEONG did not know until then that he has mistaken ANN. CHEONG sees ANN dating a dentist, whose name is JIMMY, later and feels lost. KEN, FIONA and the other have made some chairs using recycled material……

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: LAI wants to open her heart to MAN but he is so busy studying that he has no time for her. KEUNG requests MAN to ask FA out for him. MAN, however, tells him to give up his hope, saying that he is not good enough for FA. KEUNG falls out with MAN. The youngsters go to CHUEN’s coffee shop to study. FIONA does not show up at the coffee shop. KEN knows that she is avoiding him. Meanwhile, FIONA phones to tell him that FOOK, who works at her place, has been injured. KEN hurries to her house. KEN apologizes to FIONA for his coldness the day she gave him the music box. The two are reconciled with each other. The fortnightly test has finished. MAN claims that he will win the award. The test result has been released. KEUNG has won the Improvement Award, while both MAN and KEN have won the Best Performance Award. MAN teases that the reason why KEUNG has won the Improvement Award is that he has been doing very badly in the past……

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: KEN and others pay CHUEN and CHI a visit at the coffee shop. CHI’s boyfriend, LOK, demands her to elope with him. He is taking CHI away by force when MAN shows up. MAN and KEN work together in subduing LOK. LOK surrenders at last. MAN and KEN have become friends again since. KEI has been late for school and absent-minded recently. She has fallen behind in her training, too. SING and ANN find this strange. TING invites SING to a concert. To his huge disappointment, it is LAN again when he gets there. On the way he takes LAN home, SING tells her frankly that it is impossible for them to go any further; LAN is very upset. MAN and KEUNG are walking on the street when they see FA and YUEN together. KEUNG has a sense of loss. Later, they see YUEN being with another girl. They disrespect YUEN for going out with two girls at the same time and tell FA about this. FA does not believe what they say, however……

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The cadets are practicing the technique of taking a statement when FIONA asks KEN if he is going out with someone. KEN cannot help but laughing. The rest wonder what has happened to the two. FA is knitting a scarf for YUEN. MAN advises her not to be fooled, only to be told not to be nosy. KEN and his classmates cannot stand the provocation of Class B and have a fight with them. As a result, they have all been punished by SING; MAN is dissatisfied. ANN tells the class there will be patrol training. FIONA is delighted to know that she is patrolling with KEN. SING drives KEN home. KEN has cooked some spring-onion and ginger crabs for dinner and the two get along very well. Meanwhile, CHEONG gets home. He teases that they are like father and son and annoys KEN. MAN sees YUEN dating another girl again and so he asks FA to come over……

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: MAN and KEN are envious that HO has broken seven records. When WONG CHING KIT and SZETO CHEUK are on a patrol practice, they see HO and FONG MAN HON are sneaking out of the school. HO warns KIT to remain silent. CHEUK reports this to the school. HO and HON challenge CHEUK and KIT to a competition. KEN sees KIT weeping. KIT tells him in tears that he is good for nothing. SING asks KEN about the competition. KEN replies that he is helping KIT to regain his self-confidence. KEN encourages KIT with what he has gone through in the US and tells him to face the challenge with bravery. KIT insists on finishing the competition despite his injury. He loses in the end, yet he loses with grace. TAI tells FIONA that her marriage with YUEN will be helpful to both family businesses; FIONA feels helpless. TING is looking for a shop assistant; MAN recommends FA to her……

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: FIONA tells KEN off, saying that he should not have left and embarrassed her. KEN retorts that she is too willful and selfish. KEN takes to beer when he gets home. He also tells SING about his childhood. FIONA apologizes to KEN in the class but he neglects her. CHEONG bumps into ANN in the car park. He is a bit displeased when she tells him that she has given up keeping her dog for JIMMY. TING has found among her things a book that SING gave her a long time ago, and comes to know that he has been in love with her secretly. She is at a loss as to how to handle this. The HO family is overjoyed that MING has been released from jail and they decide to celebrate. It is the first day that FA works at TING’s shop. TING finds her performance very satisfactory. FA is worried when she sees MING mingle with some bad guys. When the cadets are practicing using pepper sprayers, FIONA, who is emotional, asks KEN if he loves her……

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: A customer of TING is looking for an old style doorknob. FA has found one for her; LAN is displeased. LAI comes to know that FA was the one who informed MAN of her selling the mobile. She steals the doorknob and scolds FA for hanging around TING and MAN for her own benefits. MING goes to a kickboxing gym and learns that there will be an Asian kickboxing competition. He is tempted. The two classes are having a physical obstacle race. Class B has lost under the provocation of HO. SING knows that TING is avoiding him. He later learns the reason from LAN. LAN says TING should tell SING the truth if she does not want to lose a good friend. TING asks SING out. They have a heart-to-heart talk and have become good friends again. LAN wrongly accused LAI of stealing money and she leaves home in anger. MAN and FA look for LAI at a karaoke bar but she is not there. FA has twisted her ankle and so MAN piggybacks her home……

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Seeing that SING is in a bad mood, KEN invites him to go Yum Cha with him. When they get to the restaurant, FOOK is dissatisfied to see SING. MAN takes FA by force to see a bonesetter; FA is pleased. WAH comes to see MAN and LAI and he can see that TING’s is much friendlier to him. TING also lets him stay for dinner and sleep over night. WAH is overjoyed. LAI wants to study overseas. WAH goes and buys an education fund for her and is astounded to be told that TING has cancer. FIONA falls down. She is sad that KEN does not give her a hand and decides to give up her hope on him. LING’s boyfriend, LEUNG, has turned to another girl. She cries over this. PONG hands over a paper tissue to her, only to be scolded and hit. When he gets home, MING learns that his father, SUM, has been beaten by other pickpockets, and that his grandma, CHING, has twisted her ankle when she worked as an extra……

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: TING lets WAH move in and share a room with MAN. MAN is happy that his mum is starting to accept WAH again. The girls bump into LEUNG at a disco. He wants to get back to LING as soon as he sees how attractive she has become. TING and her family go to Ocean Park. MAN worries that something has happened when FA refuses to join them. FIONA asks FOOK to return KEN’s goggles. When he sees KEN, he asks how he is going with FIONA. KEN bumps into FIONA at school and she gives him the cold shoulder. KEUNG is busy preparing for the Hong Kong Selection of the Asian Kickboxing Competition. MAN cheers him on. MAN deliberately tells everybody loudly that his whole family has gone to Ocean Park the other day. SING is a bit jealous to hear this. FA has handed in her resignation to TING; MAN is uneasy. A customer, Mrs. CHAN, thinks highly of FA’s interior design……

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: MING swears to beat KEUNG when he knows that KEUNG will be his opponent at the kickboxing competition. MING, realizing how much likes designing, shows his support for her to return to Lok On Kui. She promises him that she will not have any connection with MAN. FA shows up at Lok On Kui; TING is overexcited. LAN thinks of her own future when she sees FA working so hard towards her dream. Without herself realizing it, she has come to CHUEN’s Children Dream Coffee Shop. LAN uses tarot cards to forecast the fortune of the customers there. To her own surprise, this has given her a sense of achievement. TING has come across SING and they act as if they were strangers. TING has a sense of loss. KEUNG lacks confidence in the competition and thinks of quitting. SING gives him a good telling-off and it comes like an awakening to him. LING is buying a model for LEUNG with PONG when she sees him going out with another girl. LING cries over this……

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: CHEONG loses his hope on ANN when JIMMY comes to the training school and proposes to her with a song. MAN and KEN have broken many records in the physical training and gives face to Class A. Some loan sharks have come to TING’s place to look for WAH. It turns out that it is his ex-girlfriend who has owned them money, and that he is her guarantor. SUM has been beaten up for his gambling debt. MING promises to repay the debt. The loan sharks have come again and demand TING to repay WAH’s debt. Meanwhile, SING comes to her rescue. TING is very grateful to him. MAN invites FA to a meal but he is given the cold shoulder. The youngsters are celebrating KEUNG’s winning at CHUEN’s coffee shop when MAN is surprised to see LAN act as a fortune teller there. CHEONG is depressed. SING encourages him to express his love for ANN. Although they are living together, anybody can see that TING and WAH are at variance……

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: CHEONG looks for the taxi everywhere on a motor. He has arrived in a warehouse. It turns out that the man who has taken ANN away was the man ANN arrested four years ago. Now that he has been released from jail he comes to revenge her. CHEONG comes to save ANN just when the man is about to attack ANN with a knife. CHEONG grabs the chance to show his love for her. MAN is in a rage when he sees SING holding TING at Lok On Kui in his arms. He also accuses SING of ruining his parents’ relationship. MAN finds it hard to believe when WAH tells him how he had left TING and the family for another woman years ago. He is shocked too when WAH tells him TING has angioma. MAN gives vent to his anger during training. What is more, he studies so hard that he even forgets to eat and sleep. All are worried about him. MAN takes to drinking at a bar to forget his sorrows. FA, who has been following him, stops him from drinking anymore……

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: MAN is suspected to have been assaulted KAM MO. FA defends him in no time. MING says he will tell her who did it, on the condition that she keeps away from MAN. ANN points out that MAN may be kicked out. MAN loves being a police officer and so turns to SING for help. MAN is very nervous while he is waiting for the result. He is grateful that his fellows support him with their signatures. WAH tells TING that he is going to go to Beijing for work. TING tells him in return that she will not file a divorce. WAH is pleased. FA has been avoiding MAN, who asks her how she feels about him. He is upset when she tells him they are only friends. FIONA gives KEN an expensive watch in front of others. Feeling that his pride is hurt, he throws the watch on the floor and breaks it. FIONA leaves in a rage. FIONA vents her grievances to FA. She is taking FA home when they see MING and KAM MO together……

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: KAM MO and his gang have arrived at FIONA’s house in a car. FIONA recognized them as they are subduing FOOK. MING leaves in a hurry and bumps into KEN when KAM MO is kidnapping FIONA. He knocks KEN down; KEN falls into unconsciousness. FIONA has woken up. She is shocked to see KEN has also been kidnapped. KEN is trying to escape when FIONA asks if he loves her. KEN smiles and nods. MING wants to help KEN and FIONA leave but he has been discovered. KEN and FIONA have got out of there after much effort. KEN brings FOOK home. FOOK tries to speak but then gives it a second thought when he sees KEN and SING getting along so well. FA is going to where MING is to help him leave Hong Kong. MAN follows her to MING’s place and persuades him to turn himself in. Meanwhile, the police have arrived. MING scolds FA for betraying him. KEN sees on the paper a photo of a man who has been beaten by a Head-hitting gang……

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: KEN goes to the hospital to take CHUNG home; CHUNG is rather surprised. TING and WAH are on board a liner for a holiday. In order not to be in the same room with WAH, TING tells him that she would like to go singing in the Karaoke bar. WAH sees through this and tells her she needs not force herself to be reunited with him just for the sake for their children. MING has returned home on a bail. He and the other family members blame FA and even kick her out of the house. WAH announces that he is divorcing TING. Both MAN and LAI are stunned. FA cries in front of MAN. She rushes to hospital with him when she knows CHING has an accident and been sent to hospital. MING beats and scolds MAN for instigating his sister to betray him. FA, who is in tears, goes between the two men. FA has been forgiven by her family. She advises MING acting as a witness against KAM MO. MING accepts and claims that he will not stop her from going out with MAN again……

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: SING asks Brother SAU, who has retreated from the triad, to help find the whereabouts of LUNG. SING comes across TING. They go to the movie and have dinner together. LAN tells TING to get hold of the opportunity to go a step further with SING. KEN still cannot accept CHUNG as his father. But he thinks otherwise when he hears CHUNG making a confession to his late mother in front of her shrine. The father and son go fishing together. When he gets home and sees CHUNG there, SING suspects that CHUNG is harboring a bad intention. FIONA sees KEN buying a birthday cake. She follows him and finds out that he is celebrating CHUNG’s birthday. CHUNG tells FIONA that it is his dream to lead a peaceful life at a farm in the US when he learns that she comes from a wealthy family. FIONA offers to give him some help but KEN declines her kindness. SING is rather shocked when KEN says he wants to sell his share of the house to him to help CHUNG……

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Gathering up all his courage, MAN asks SING if he likes TING. He also claims that he will not mind if SING goes out with her so long as she is happy. SING is overjoyed. SING confesses his love for TING; she is at a loss as to how to response. FIONA borrows 100,000 dollars from TAI after she has received a call. It is found out that CHUNG is heavily in debt. SING asks him why he has to deceive KEN. CHUNG discloses that KEN is in fact not his son, and all he wants is money. He further points out that KEN will be hurt if he learns about the truth. KEN asks CHUNG why he is injured. CHUNG replies that SING has hit him over the selling of the house. KEN goes negotiating with SING. He is very upset later when he finds CHUNG has always left the hospital. FOOK has returned from Mainland China. SING did not know until then that KEN is his son. SING suggests throwing a party on her birthday……

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: SING says “Sorry” to KEN before he dies. KEN breaks down. TING bursts into tears when she watches from the TV the news of SING’s death. Everybody in the training school is distressed. KEN pretends to be calm and he talks about SING’s things in the past with CHEONG. All are shocked and surprised when ANN tells them the relationship between KEN and SING. Under the arrangement of KEN, SING’s funeral will be on the same day of the passing-out ceremony. Despite of what has happened recently, he insists on continuing his training. As for other cadets, they are so sad that they do not have the mood to prepare for the exam. KEN comes and cheers them up; they find it unbelievable that he can be so calm. The exam result has been out. MAN and HO have won the Silver Whistle Award of Classes A and B respectively. TING tells KEN what SING has said when he learnt that KEN was his son; tears fill his eyes……
